Track details

Click a track on the map or in the track list to open its details. On a phone, tap Restore panel size before dragging the panel down to make it smaller. If you opened details from Statistics or Filter, Back returns to that list.

Tab What it shows
Overview Distance, time, energy, and heart rate
Graphs Speed, elevation, and other values over time or distance
Quality Why a value is missing or unreliable
Related Other tracks nearby or on the same route
Media Photos and videos from this activity
Events Breaks and GPS gaps

Values can be missing when the file has gaps or no timestamps. Missing is not the same as zero.

On this page
  • Events
  • Download and replay

Events

Events lists breaks and GPS gaps with their start, end, and duration. Click one to show it on the map. A GPS gap means positions are missing; it doesn't prove you stopped. Use the map's Events switch to show or hide all event markers.

Download and replay

Download the original file or a GPX version. 3D Replay needs a track with timestamps and no big gaps; see replay.
